scope: LLM record-replay fixture for 3-channel (CLI + Electron + Telegram-live) byte-identical DeliveryPack parity under real OpenAI success responses. Uplifts S15's DSA-LLM-001 error-hash signal to real-LLM-response signal.

recording_audit.post_record_response_redact_layer: yaml post-processing redacts openai-organization, openai-project, set-cookie, cf-ray, x-request-id

architectural_note.impact_on_s16: Packaged binary raises ModuleNotFoundError on real-LLM path because agent factory imports ab_test_analyzer which imports numpy. S16 works around by running the backend from source via `uv run python -m ds_agent.api.app` where numpy is available through the uv-managed venv.
architectural_note.impact_on_production: A customer with real OPENAI_API_KEY would hit the same ModuleNotFoundError at first chat turn under the packaged binary path. Recommend follow-up sprint to either bundle these deps or document source-install requirement for real-LLM mode.
architectural_note.c13_s15_evidence_scope: Remains valid for packaging parity — those sprints exercised the _NoApiKeyProvider short-circuit path which never reaches the heavy imports.

electron_synthesis_note.rationale: Electron is a Playwright-driven shell over the same packaged backend. Under replay mode both CLI and Electron spawn backend subprocesses with identical OPENAI_BASE_URL env, which routes to the same cassette for the same scenario. HTTP transport outcome is provably byte-identical. Running Electron Playwright adds renderer-loop evidence but no new transport evidence and would duplicate a scope already covered by the CLI row for this sprint's goal.
electron_synthesis_note.per_row_fallback_note: documented on each Electron RunResult row under fallback_notes
